the present study has added one more record to the existing list of Proterozoicrocks, where coated grains and associated microfossil assem-blages are found in association.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the Deoban ooids and pisoids were not produced by single species of microbes but by a consortium of microbes which included cyanobacteria, bacteria and acritarchs.
